svg.aria-label: URL frontier with two modules. Front queues handle priority: a prioritizer scores incoming URLs and puts them in queues f1 (high) to fn (low), and a selector picks from them at random with a bias toward high priority. Back queues handle politeness: a router uses a host-to-queue mapping table so each queue b1 to bn holds one host's URLs, and each worker thread drains exactly one queue, one page at a time with a delay.
svg.title: URL frontier
